hard_constraints.signal_window: first 2 minutes of each 5m candle only
checkpoints: A: immediately after the 1st closed 1m sub-candle (t+1min)
B: immediately after the 2nd closed 1m sub-candle (t+2min); only evaluated if A did not fire
hard_constraints.outcome_rule: compare issued direction to final close vs open of the 5m candle; tie (close==open) counted as Red

validation_methodology.out_of_sample_role: independent validation only, never used in strategy selection
